exactness_scope: Exact finite-horizon DP for the current toy binary-failure, tau=1 repair, and DC-OPF model; numerical LP tolerances apply.

state_space.state_index_encoding: base-3, component 0 is the least-significant digit
state_space.mask_encoding: binary, component 0 is the least-significant bit

saved_sddip_comparison.parameter_match_note: The saved SDDiP JSON does not contain complete parameter metadata. This comparison assumes its path, seed, repair scale, and budget correspond to the exact-DP run.
saved_sddip_comparison.legacy_field_interpretation: One training forward-pass cost; not a policy upper bound.
saved_sddip_comparison.policy_mean_note: This is the exact sample mean of the 500 in-sample policy simulations reconstructed from saved mean quantities. Individual costs and their variance were not saved.
